title: Vitesse Energy, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Vitesse Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026, reporting the issuance of 1,935,698 shares of common stock to a third-party seller in exchange for non-operated oil and gas assets. The company also entered into a registration rights agreement granting resale registration rights to the seller.
key_points: On April 8, 2026, Vitesse Energy issued 1,935,698 shares of common stock (par value $0.01) as consideration for non-operated oil and gas assets
The share issuance was conducted pursuant to Section 4(a)(2) exemption from Securities Act registration requirements
A registration rights agreement was executed on April 8, 2026, obligating the company to file a shelf registration statement for resale of the issued shares
The company agreed to pay all fees and expenses for the registration and reasonable fees of one special legal counsel up to $100,000 per underwritten offering
Vitesse Energy trades as VTS on the New York Stock Exchange
The company is incorporated in Delaware and based in Greenwood Village, Colorado
